title: keraselma peplus
intro: Keraselma peplus, commonly known as the Celandine plant, is a perennial herb belonging to the poppy family (Papaveraceae). It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat skin conditions such as warts, eczema, and acne, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties which can help to reduce pain and swelling. The therapeutic actions of Keraselma peplus include its antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in the treatment of various infections and conditions. The bioactive constituents of Keraselma peplus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
